reference_sql:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM product_rev
)
SELECT category_name,
       SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 2) AS top2_revenue,
       SUM(revenue) AS category_revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 2) / SUM(revenue), 1) AS top2_share_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY category_name
alternatives:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
placed AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT pr.category_name, pr.revenue,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_rev pr2
          WHERE pr2.category_name = pr.category_name
            AND (pr2.revenue > pr.revenue OR (pr2.revenue = pr.revenue AND pr2.product_id < pr.product_id))) AS ahead
  FROM product_rev pr
)
SELECT category_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ahead < 2 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top2_revenue,
       SUM(revenue) AS category_revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ahead < 2 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / SUM(revenue), 1) AS top2_share_pct
FROM placed
GROUP BY category_name

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn

),
top2 AS (  -- one row per category with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, SUM(revenue) AS top2_revenue
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY category_name
),
total AS (  -- one row per category with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, SUM(revenue) AS category_revenue
  FROM product_rev
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT t.category_name, t.top2_revenue, a.category_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * t.top2_revenue / a.category_revenue, 1) AS top2_share_pct
FROM top2 t
JOIN total a ON a.category_name = t.category_name

solver.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY category_name, product_id),
r AS (SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn FROM p),
t AS (SELECT category_name, SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 2) AS top2_revenue, SUM(revenue) AS category_revenue FROM r GROUP BY category_name)
SELECT category_name, top2_revenue, category_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * top2_revenue / category_revenue, 1) AS top2_share_pct FROM t
